workflow_rationale: Single-service Node.js tooling to analyze and migrate token bindings. No multi-service dependencies, no staged rollout needed. Tool produces reports and migration files for manual review and application.

phases.name: Build Migration Tool
phases.description: Build the core token migration analysis and mapping tool

subtasks.description: Create token binding analyzer - scans token file and identifies primitive usage

verification.expected: Outputs list of primitive bindings found

subtasks.implementation_notes: Parse azmx-tokens.json, identify all primitive tokens (size/*, color/* from '1. Primitives'), trace where they're referenced vs semantic alternatives. Output: JSON with category breakdown (spacing, typography, radius, border) and usage counts.
subtasks.notes: Created scripts/analyze-token-bindings.mjs - Successfully analyzes token bindings and identifies primitive usage. Verification passed with --dry-run flag. Found 415 total primitive bindings: 218 unique primitives referenced, 67 unreferenced. Breakdown: Palette (114), Semantic (297), Component (0), Canvas (4). Supports --dry-run and --verbose flags for detailed output.

subtasks.description: Create migration mapper - generates primitive-to-semantic mappings with confidence scores

verification.expected: Returns nearest semantic token (space/3xs or space/2xs) with confidence score

subtasks.implementation_notes: For each primitive binding: (1) Identify category (spacing/typography/radius/border), (2) Find nearest semantic token by value matching, (3) Assign confidence: HIGH (exact match), MEDIUM (nearest neighbor), LOW (off-scale value), MANUAL (ambiguous). Handle off-scale values like 12px gap → suggest space/3xs (8) or space/2xs (16) with MANUAL flag.
subtasks.notes: Created scripts/generate-migration-map.mjs - Successfully generates primitive-to-semantic mappings with confidence scores. Supports --test-case for individual testing and --json for full export. Analyzes 285 primitives: 72 HIGH confidence (exact matches), 6 MEDIUM (nearest neighbors), 4 LOW (off-scale), 203 MANUAL (colors/fonts/ambiguous). Verification passed with size/space/12 returning both space/3xs and space/2xs with MANUAL confidence.

subtasks.description: Create migration report generator - produces human-readable summary and category breakdown

verification.expected: Creates report.md with total bindings, auto-mappable count, manual-review count, category breakdown

subtasks.implementation_notes: Read migration map JSON, generate markdown report with: (1) Executive summary (total primitives, auto-mappable %, manual review %), (2) Category breakdown (spacing: X bindings, typography: Y, etc.), (3) High-priority manual reviews (off-scale values), (4) Detailed mapping table. Format matches existing brand-check.py output style.

subtasks.description: Create Figma migration file generator - outputs DTCG format for Figma import

verification.expected: Creates migration.json in DTCG format compatible with Figma import

subtasks.implementation_notes: Read migration map, convert to DTCG v2025.10 format (see export-figma-tokens.js lines 97-134). For each primitive→semantic mapping, create a token update operation. Only include HIGH and MEDIUM confidence mappings. Flag MANUAL and LOW for separate review file.

phases.name: Integration & Testing
phases.description: Wire all scripts together, test end-to-end workflow, validate output

subtasks.description: Create orchestrator script that runs full migration pipeline

verification.expected: Runs full pipeline: analyze → map → report → export. Creates all output files.

subtasks.implementation_notes: Main orchestrator that: (1) Runs analyze-token-bindings.mjs, (2) Passes results to generate-migration-map.mjs, (3) Creates report via create-migration-report.mjs, (4) Exports to Figma via export-migration-to-figma.mjs. CLI flags: --analyze-only, --report-only, --export-only for running individual steps.

subtasks.description: End-to-end validation - run migration tool against azmx-tokens.json and verify outputs

steps: Run migrate-tokens.mjs against real token file
Verify migration map identifies ~430 primitive bindings
Check report shows breakdown by category
Confirm off-scale values (12px, 40px) flagged for manual review
Validate DTCG export file structure matches Figma import format

subtasks.implementation_notes: Test with real azmx-tokens.json. Expected results based on spec: ~430 primitive bindings, 12px gaps (16 uses), 40px fonts (51 uses). Verify these are found and correctly categorized. Check that exact matches get HIGH confidence, nearest neighbors get MEDIUM, off-scale get MANUAL flag.

subtasks.description: Add documentation - README for tool usage, examples, and migration workflow

verification.instructions: Review MIGRATION_TOOL.md for completeness: usage instructions, CLI flags, output formats, workflow steps, troubleshooting

subtasks.implementation_notes: Document: (1) Installation/prerequisites, (2) CLI usage with examples, (3) Understanding the report, (4) How to review manual flags, (5) Importing migration file to Figma, (6) Verifying tokens-to-css.mjs produces same output post-migration. Include example report output.

parallelism.speedup_estimate: Sequential execution required - each subtask builds on previous

acceptance_criteria: Tool successfully identifies ~430 primitive bindings from token file
Migration map assigns appropriate confidence scores (HIGH/MEDIUM/MANUAL)
Off-scale values (12px gaps, 40px fonts) flagged for manual review
Report shows total bindings, auto-mappable count, manual-review count, category breakdown
DTCG export file is valid and Figma-importable
Documentation explains usage, workflow, and how to apply migration

verification_strategy.reasoning: Low risk data processing tool. No production code changes, no database migrations. Output files require manual review before application. Verification focuses on tool functionality and output quality.

steps: Review migration report for accuracy of primitive identification
Verify confidence scores make sense (exact matches = HIGH, near matches = MEDIUM, off-scale = MANUAL)
Check that off-scale values (12px, 40px) are correctly flagged
Validate DTCG export file structure against Figma import requirements
Confirm report shows ~430 total bindings as specified in acceptance criteria
